top_signals.title: UAE: Dubai’s Financial Hub DIFC Tops 10,000 Firms Despite War Risks
top_signals.summary: Dubai’s financial hub topped 10,000 active registered companies for the first time, underscoring the emirate’s continued success in attracting global firms despite a period of heightened geopolitical tensions in the region.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
